verses.text: Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha jun tik in chekab', ayin och yet'ok, a in in sik'nakeli, tzin tzalaj wal yet'ok. Ol wak'och Wespíritu t'ay, yik sch'olb'itej masanil niwak chonhab' t'a stojolal.
Manh ol awajok, manh ol ab'chaj yel yaw t'a yoltak calle.
Ay heb' te ilb'aj k'o'ol, icha te' aj skanhchaji, ma ichok sk'apakil candil wan stupi. Palta ol kolwaj in chekab' chi' t'a heb', manh ol swach' ixtej heb', tojol ol yutok sch'olb'itan tas yaj heb'.

Manh ol el yip, manh ol chab'ax sk'o'ol. Ol ch'olb'itaj masanil anima t'a stojolal yuj t'a sat lum tik. Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a stitak ha' mar, ol smaklej yab' k'ayb'ub'al heb' ol yak'a', xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Dios b'oannak satcha'anh, yak'annakb'at jenhan. A' ixb'o'an lum lum yet' masanil tastak sk'ib' t'a sat lu'um. Ha tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, syak'anpax kik'. Syalan t'a jun schekab' chi' icha tik:

Ha in Jehová in tik, ix ach wawtej yik tza ch'olb'itej masanil anima t'a sat lu'um tik t'a stojolal. Ol in och het'ok. Ha ach ol ach wak'lab'ej yuj jun in trato ol in b'o yet' heb' anima smasanil. Ol ach wak'och kolwajwumal t'a heb' ch'ok nacional.
Ol a jak sat heb' max uji yilani, ol a kolanelta heb' ayoch t'a preso, haton heb' aykanb'at t'a kal k'ik' k'inal.
Ha in ton Jehová in, haton in b'i tik, manh ol in cha aljok wach' lolonel t'a junokxo mach yuj tas in b'onak, manh ol in cha ik'jokcha'anh yechel komon Dios in k'exulok.
Ileknab' tas ix aj yelk'och masanil tas walnakkani. Haxo tikne'ik, ay juntzanhxo tas ak'to ol wal t'ayex. Ayokto swalankan t'ayex yakb'an manto ujok, xchi Dios.

B'itejek junok ak' b'it t'a Jehová he masanil ex ayex b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ex tzex ek' t'a yib'anh ha' mar, nok' nok' ay t'a ha' yet' ex pax kajan ex t'a stitak ha' mar chi', b'itananhek t'a Dios.
Tzalajokab' heb' yinhtilal Cedar kajan t'a scampamento t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha heb' aj chonhab' Sela, b'itanokab' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, k'eokab' sjaj heb' sb'itan t'a lum jolomtak witz.
Ha heb' ay t'a stitak ha' mar, yalokab' wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová.
Ol elta Jehová icha junok ak'um owal, ol yak'an owal yet' wal yowal sk'o'ol icha junok soldado. Ol el yaw yak'an owal, ol ak'jok ganar heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Najtil numannhej waji, malaj tas swala'. Haxo tikne'ik, ol el waw icha junok ix ix wan yaj yune', sk'akwi ix, sik'sik'an ix.
Ol laj in satel lum witz yet' lum tzalkixtak. Ol wak'an takjokel masanil tas ya'ax t'a sat lum tik. Ol wak'an tup ha' niwak ha' sb'eyi. Ol ochkan lum takinh lumal, ol laj tupkan ha' skan t'a yet'tal.

Ha heb' max ujilaj yilani, ol wik'b'at heb' t'a juntzanh b'e manh yojtakok. Ha k'ik' k'inal, ol wak' meltzajoch sakilk'inalil t'a heb'. Haxo pak'kiltak, panhanxo ol wutejkani. Haton juntzanh tik ol wak'nhejelk'ochi.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch komon Dios yipok sk'o'ol yet' heb' tz'alan t'a juntzanh yechel icha tik: Ko diosal ex, xchi heb', a heb' chi' k'ixwelal ol laj paxkan heb'.
Ex max eyab'i, ab'ek. Ex max uji heyilani, ilek tikne'ik.
Malaj mach junelnhej max ilan icha in chekab' sik'b'ilel wu'uj, malaj mach junelnhej max cha'an yab' icha yalumalel in lolonel chekb'il wu'uj.
Ex israel, te aynhej tas sch'oxji heyila', palta max eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol heyilani. Syal eyab'ani, palta max he cha eyab'i, xchi Jehová.
Ix snib'ej sk'ol Jehová sch'oxanel stojolal, yuj chi' ix yak' sk'ayb'ub'al te wach' t'a schonhab'.

Palta yuj spitalil jun chonhab' tik ix elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'ay yuj heb' ajk'o'ol. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a ch'ok nacional, ix ak'chajem heb' t'a yol jul, ix och pax heb' t'a preso. Ix ixtaj heb', manhxa mach ix kolan heb'. Ix elk'ajb'at heb', manhxa mach ix ik'anek' heb' t'a heb' ix elk'anb'at chi'.
Palta ¿mach ex b'ekan he k'ol he maklan eyab' tas ol wal tik? ¿Mach ex b'ekan he k'ol he cha'annhej eyab'i? Ab'ek tas ol wal tik:

¿Mach ix cha'an ak'jok ganar heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob, ayik ix elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'a heb'? ¿Tom manhok Jehová? Hatoni, yujto ix och smul heb' t'ay. Maj yal sk'ol heb' ix sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al, maj sk'anab'ajej pax sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová chi' heb'.
Yuj wal chi' jun, ix kot yowal Jehová t'a heb', ix ak'jioch syahelal heb'. Ix jawi jun owal icha sk'e nhilnhon te' k'ak' t'a yib'anh heb', palta manh yujok chi' ix sna sb'a heb'.
